verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents building custom 'pieces' (connectors) in TypeScript with a fast dev loop, plus a full API with key-based auth and an SDK for embedding/customizing the platform. This directly matches the story of building custom connectors/private integrations via a documented developer platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the pieces SDK workflow (one community comment notes uncertainty about documentation quality for adding custom integrations) and no public OpenAPI spec found via probes.
